changes.text: 三年三月，锦棠攻克达坂城，悉释所擒缠回，纵之归。南路恟惧；次日收托克逊城，另部连破诸城隘，收吐鲁番，降缠回万余。接着是帕夏的结局：饮药死，其子伯克胡里戕其弟，走喀什噶尔。放回俘虏与南路恟惧，传记写在一处。

In the third month of the third year Jintang took Dabancheng and released every captured Muslim of the south, sending them home. Panic spread through the south; the next day Toksun fell, other columns stormed the cities and passes and recovered Turpan, and more than ten thousand Muslims submitted. Then Pasha's end: he drank poison and died; his son Bokhuli killed his own brother and fled to Kashgar. The freeing of the captives and the panic in the south are set down side by side.
崇厚得罪去，命曾纪泽使俄更前约，左宗棠自请出屯哈密，规复伊犁。六年四月，他「輿櫬發肅州」——抬着棺材从肃州出发，五月抵哈密。俄闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，别以兵船翔海上，用震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东皆警。七月诏左宗棠入都备顾问，由西征将领锦棠接替他；传记称「俄亦懾我兵威」，明年正月和议成，交还伊犁，防海军皆罢。

Chong Hou was disgraced and removed, and Zeng Jize sent to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo asked to move out to Hami to prepare the recovery of Ili. In the fourth month of the sixth year he set out from Suzhou "carrying his coffin" and reached Hami in the fifth. Russia, hearing the imperial army was moving in force, reinforced Ili and the Naryn and put warships to sea to shake the capital; Tianjin, Fengtian and Shandong were all on alert. In the seventh month Zuo was summoned to the capital as an adviser, and Jintang, a commander of the expedition, replaced him; the biography, written from the Qing side, says Russia too was cowed by the might of the Qing army. In the first month of the following year peace was concluded, Ili returned, and the coastal forces stood down.

仗打赢之后，外部的看法也变了。国家承平久，武备弛不振，而海外诸国争言富强，虽中国屡平大难，仍私议以为脆弱；及宗棠平帕夏，外国乃稍稍传说之。京师民间另有一则传言：左宗棠初入京师时，内城有教堂高楼俯瞰宫殿，民间讙言「左侯至，樓即毀矣」；后出示谕晓，传言乃止，原文未明言示谕者是谁。传记以「其威望在人如此」收束此事，随即转笔：左宗棠在军机、译署任上（此职系入觐后所授，传记记于前文），「同列頗厭苦之」，他本人也「自不樂居內，引疾乞退」。

After the victories, opinion abroad shifted. The empire had been at peace so long that its armaments had gone slack, while the overseas powers vied with one another in talk of wealth and power; even though China had put down one great crisis after another, they still privately judged it frail. Once Zuo had dealt with Pasha, the foreigners began to spread the word about him. Within the capital there was a separate, domestic rumor: when Zuo first entered the capital, a church tower in the Inner City overlooked the palace, and people in the city said the tower would come down once the Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain, and the talk stopped. The record does not say who issued the notice. The biography closes the episode by calling it a measure of his prestige, then turns: in his posts at the Grand Council and the foreign-affairs office (conferred after his audience, as the biography records earlier), his colleagues found him a great trial, and Zuo himself, unhappy serving in the capital, pleaded illness and asked to retire.
左宗棠的奏折把这笔割地换和平的账摊开：俄视伊犁为外府，及我索地，俄则索偿卢布五百万元，所以俄还伊犁于俄无损，我所得不过一荒郊；崇厚又议畀俄陬尔果斯河及帖克斯河，是划伊犁西南之地归俄。他说：「茲一矢未加，遽捐要地」，界务不可许；俄商志在贸易，其政府广设领事，欲藉通商深入腹地，商务也不可许。他给的次序是：「當先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝。」

Zuo's memorial laid out the ledger for trading land for peace. Russia treated Ili as an outlying treasury, and when China asked for the land back, Russia demanded five million rubles in compensation; so returning Ili would cost Russia nothing, and what China got back would be "only a stretch of empty outskirts"; Chong Hou was meanwhile offering Russia the Korgos and Tekes rivers, ceding the southwest of Ili outright. "Not a single arrow has been loosed," Zuo wrote, "and we are to give up a key position at once": the boundary terms must not be granted. Russian merchants were after trade, but their government was planting consulates everywhere, hoping to use commerce to reach deep into the interior; those trade terms must not be granted either. His order of operations: "first let there be discussion, subtle and flexible; then decide it in battle, patient and determined to win."

dispositions.rationale: 中文补入“南路恟惧”，置于释俘与收托克逊之间，不添因果；末句改为“放回俘虏与南路恟惧”，与前文呼应。顺手把繁体“托克遜”统一为“托克逊”。英文末句同步改为 the panic in the south，中英一致。

evidence.quote: 悉釋所擒纏回，縱之歸。南路恟懼，翼日，收托克遜城

dispositions.rationale: 英文改为 the biography, written from the Qing side, says Russia too was cowed by the might of the Qing army，点明这是传记的清方口吻，不再像作者本人的判断。按规则，英文不加引号冒充原文。中文改为用「」逐字引原文「俄亦懾我兵威」，标明这是传记用语。
中文补回“争言富强”，并删去原文没有的“见”字，改为“虽中国屡平大难，仍私议以为脆弱”。英文删去无据的 among themselves，把“争言富强”（vied with one another in talk of wealth and power）与“私议”（privately judged）分开译述，中英对等。

evidence.quote: 海外諸國爭言富強，雖中國屢平大難，彼猶私議以為脆弱也

dispositions.rationale: 中英两版都补入奏折中的前提：俄视伊犁为外府，及我索地，俄索偿卢布五百万元，因此俄还伊犁于俄无损。英文用 five million rubles，与中文“五百万”一致，两版都没有阿拉伯数字。

evidence.quote: 俄視伊犁為外府，及我索地，則索償盧布五百萬元。是俄還伊犁，於俄無損
